title: wallets.consumption_order
description: Which inbound transactions of a traceable wallet an outbound amount consumes, and how much from each (BE-WL-13..16).

inbound_id.description: Id of one of the `inbound` entries to consume from (BE-WL-14). It must name an entry: an unknown transaction is rejected earlier by the request validation (`wallet_transaction_not_found`, BE-WL-6), so it is outside this op's domain.
